caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric, possibly a tapestry or embroidered textile, suspended by a rod at the top. The fabric is primarily beige with embroidery in shades of blue, brown, and a touch of reddish-brown, displaying an intricate design that includes foliage, flowers, and animals. The central and most dominant motif is a symmetrical floral arrangement that extends outward, with curling vines, leaves, and a variety of stylized flowers spreading across the surface. Among the foliage, there are small animals, such as birds and deer, distributed throughout the composition. The tapestry has a slightly worn and frayed edge, especially noticeable at the bottom and sides. Some cross-hatch patterns and geometric motifs are visible, particularly in the corners and along the lower edge, where the name "WILLIAMS" is embroidered in block letters. The background is an off-white color, isolating the fabric and giving it prominence. The rod from which the textile hangs is a simple line drawing in gray, with pointed finials at each end.
title: Embroidered Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
